TAL_UNMAKING_BITTER_RELEASE.why: Overdraw: add Proficiency Bonus Ruin damage, or twice that against a target that is Bloodied, Restrained, Stunned, Incapacitated, or unable to take Reactions (combat/unmaking.py).

TAL_UNMAKING_BLACK_VEIN_STEP.why: When you Overdraw, 10 feet of free movement after the triggering talent resolves; the extra unarmed strike for 1 more Black Vein Strain if you end adjacent to the damaged creature is a GM-only rider (combat/unmaking.py).

TAL_UNMAKING_WOUND_THAT_REFUSES.why: Damaging a creature with Ruin Channel or Black Trace (Unbound Trace included): it cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn (combat/unmaking.py).

TAL_UNMAKING_LAST_INCH_CONTROL.why: Before gaining Black Vein Strain, once per turn, a Constitution save against your own Unmaking Save DC trades the Strain for Proficiency Bonus Ruin self-damage on a success (combat/unmaking.py).

TAL_UNMAKING_SPLINTERING_TRACE.why: One extra d10 Ruin damage (two at CL 11) when Black Trace hits an object, barrier or other structure, or a creature the table labels a construct (combat/ext/unmaking_forms.py splintering_trace).

TAL_UNMAKING_CRACK_THE_GUARD.why: Hitting a creature through a Ruin Channel attack: its Strength-or-Constitution saving throw, of its own choice (combat/ext/unmaking_forms.py crack_the_guard through combat/ext/save_choices.py). Its defensive implement gains 1 Crack and a failed save takes away its shield AC against your attacks -- the GM's, since the game tracks Crack on your own weapons and sums Armor Class as one number.

TAL_UNMAKING_BLACK_STAR_VESSEL.why: Armed by a free toggle (combat/ext/mind_unmaking.py); when you would suffer Ruin Backlash, becomes a Black Star Vessel instead: no Strain reduction, +8d10 Ruin damage once before it ends, and you cannot regain HP for its duration. Ignoring Resistance, Disadvantage on death saves, and the second Backlash when it ends are GM-only riders (combat/unmaking.py).

TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_IDENTIFY_RHYTHMS.why: +half Proficiency Bonus (rounded down) AC against an attacker Analyzed by you (combat/ext/mind_hidden_eye.py); the same bonus to saving throws against effects of a creature Analyzed by you, while holding Martial Focus, is added by the save hook in combat/ext/lane4_saves.py.
